original.target_description: Experiment 1a; goal-conflict simple effect on log-transformed book-browsing time within leisure frame; full 2×2 ANOVA error term. Publisher-distributed accepted manuscript, April2020 version, p.16.

n.sample_role: Participants in the final Experiment 1a factorial ANOVA, from which the target simple effect is reported; model N across both activity frames, not a frame-specific subgroup count.
n.exclusions: 18 attention-check failures excluded from 228 recruited U.S. Amazon Mechanical Turk participants. No further target-model exclusions stated.
n.location: Accepted manuscript p. 14, Experiment 1a Design and Method; pp. 15–16, dependent variable and Results.
n.quote: Eighteen individuals failed an attention check and were excluded, leaving a sample of 210

replication.target_description: Replication 1, leisure-frame book-browsing task: goal conflict versus no conflict; natural log of seconds, capped at 300 seconds.

n.sample_role: Participants in the leisure-frame simple-effect comparison. Whole-study post-exclusion N is 1,008; frame-specific analytic n is not printed in the report or figure.
n.exclusions: Failed attention check; survey longer than 30 minutes; duplicate MTurk IDs or IP addresses; actual versus reported MTurk ID mismatch. Times over 300 seconds winsorized to 300 seconds.
n.quote: After exclusions, we wound up with 1,008 participants in Replication 1 and 1,127 participants in Replication 2

es.location: Results, second (leisure) hypothesis paragraph; ds ordered Replication 1 then Replication 2
es.quote: the effect sizes we observed (ds = -.13 and -.15) are much smaller than what was reported in the original (d = -.34)

p.location: Fourth footnote, time cap and winsorization, final sentence.
p.quote: For example, if we do not winsorize in this way in Replication 1, the work-frame p-value becomes .264 instead of .270, and the leisure-frame p-value remains at .088.

reported_success.location: Results, final paragraph before What About Data Quality?
reported_success.quote: On balance, then, these replications were not successful.

notes:
Original full paper unavailable; original statistics in Data Colada are secondary summaries and were not substituted for primary original extraction. Replication source title and target match verified. The report gives only whole-study post-exclusion N, not the analytic sample size of the assigned frame-specific test. Replication effect sizes and p values refer to the same frame-specific contrast on log time. Reported success is the replication authors' overall verdict on both replications; original authors' feedback expresses a different interpretation. Replication 1 pre-registration was prepared but not officially submitted (footnote 2).
Source follow-up: Accepted manuscript retained as source version; PDF p.16 visually checked. Null target n avoids replacing a frame-specific sample with the total210-person model sample. Duplicate original locators independently identify the same Experiment1a simple effect.
Completion source review (n_o): Printed final post-exclusion participant sample for Experiment 1a, used in the factorial ANOVA reporting the leisure-frame high-versus-low goal-conflict contrast. Recorded as common model N, not the unreported frame-specific subgroup N. The target is identified by the supplied study/outcome/frame locator.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Explicit Replication 1 leisure-frame p value for the primary winsorized analysis. The leisure p value remains .088 in the alternative analysis without winsorization.
